assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries inferred from public announcement text and repository-maintained provisional data; they are not official redlines or cadastral/planning control boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Area and ratio metrics remain reproducible for this concept package, but they must be treated as provisional design measurements and recalculated after official boundary polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, flood-control, fire-safety, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from authoritative attachments before statutory or engineering use.
assumptions.impact: The package is suitable for concept/design-content review and reproducible spatial discussion only; it does not establish statutory controls, approvals, demolition decisions, or implementation commitments.
